Bombay No.3 Productions is hiring for Marketing Role 

About the Company

Bombay No.3 Productions is a production house in the entertainment industry, bringing creative projects to audiences. The team values thoughtful promotion, clear communication, and collaborative execution. As a Marketing Intern, you will support audience outreach and campaign work while gaining practical experience in entertainment marketing.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with planning and coordinating marketing campaigns for entertainment projects.
  • Help prepare promotional content and maintain consistent messaging across channels.
  • Research audiences, market trends, and relevant promotional opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to support campaign execution.
  • Track campaign activity and organize results, feedback, and supporting materials.

Requirements

  • Suitable for candidates with 0–2 years of experience and an interest in marketing and the entertainment industry.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through.
  • Ability to collaborate, organize multiple tasks, and contribute ideas in a fast-moving production environment.
  • This is a paid, 12-month, full-time, in-office internship based in Mumbai, with a monthly stipend of ₹20,000.
